people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
translations.bsb: And Aaron placed it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
translations.asv: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
